items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Edgar Sampson and Jimmy Mundy, they were writing all these swing arrangements for Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: -- was writing for Benny Goodman, making him a swing band, you know, like Edgar Sampson and Jimmy Mundy, they were writing all these swing arrangements for Benny Goodman. And down on 52nd Street they was letting the Caucasians come and sit in, you know, trying to steal our music. And a lot of them did.
Well, what do you think should have been done? Bop? The augmentation?
